gen-gf-warnes-fs-paquito: Confident and a bit theatrical, Warnes draws every stroke at a ruler-straight weight with spacious tracking. But Paquito underneath keeps its lowercase close to the capitals, giving the page a friendly, grounded voice.
gen-gf-funnel-display-manrope: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-thin strokes that all keep the same width. And Manrope, a sans-serif with bright open curves, settles in below to carry the text with friendly ease.
gen-gf-goldman-satoshi: Goldman spreads its letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses. Satoshi, a sans-serif, matches that generosity with rounded letters whose rims are as thick as the stems, which is the quality that ties them.
gen-gf-grandstander-work-sans: Work Sans has a contemporary, modern feel, with its mean line set high and its curves held open. Work Sans keeps a long paragraph moving smoothly beneath Grandstander's bold, constant-width heading lines.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, its lowercase sitting close to the capitals in height. Paquito carries a long paragraph with ease, while Press Start 2P's retro, far-apart letters stay up top for the fun.
gen-gf-offside-switzer: Switzer has a Swiss, approachable feel, built from tubular wire-like letters with a high waistline. Switzer sits next to Offside's widely tracked, curve-refusing heading like a tidy neighbor, quiet where Offside is loud.
gen-gf-metamorphous-general-sans: General Sans reads smoothly, with a single flat line weight and an x-height that fills the line. General Sans is the one for steady text, while Metamorphous does its best work with soft fat-and-slim strokes and commanding presence.
gen-gf-revalia-satoshi: Bold and expressive, Revalia stretches wide with a relaxed stride and an open-curved g. But Satoshi does the quieter job, setting text in a ballpoint-pen stroke width that stays friendly and easy to follow.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-karma: Wide, loud and a little cheeky up top. Karma settles underneath with trustworthy, classic manners, its thin parts clearly thinner yet never fragile, so Revalia's relaxed stride gets a sturdy partner.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-karma: Karma brings a trustworthy, classic voice, with slightly thinner curves at the tops of its rounded letters. And Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes, monoline from stem to serif, give that old-fashioned calm a distinctive, outsized neighbor.
